function Article(props) { const coverValue = props.cover const nameValue = props.name const sizeValue = props.size const priceValue = props.price const comfortValue = props.comfort const onSaleValue = props.onSale const sizeRange = ['M', 'L'] return (

Name : {nameValue}
{sizeRange.map((rangeElem) => sizeValue == rangeElem ? Taille : {rangeElem.toString()} : null)} Comfort : {comfortValue}
Price : {priceValue} €
{onSaleValue && En soldes !}
) } export default Article
